question:
Seven persons A, B, C, D, E, F and G work as Clerk, PO, IT Officer, Economist, Doctor, Lawyer and Driver (not necessarily in the same order). No two persons have the same profession. C works as a Clerk. A does not work as an Economist or a Doctor. E is not an Economist or a Doctor. B does not work as a Driver or Economist or a Doctor or a PO. F works as an IT Officer. D is not a Doctor or a PO. 

Who among the following may be working as a PO?
solution:
Given: Seven persons A, B, C, D, E, F and G work as Clerk, PO, IT Officer, Economist, Doctor, Lawyer and Driver (not necessarily in the same order). 

1) C works as a Clerk. 

2) F works as an IT Officer.
